map.碳-14、热释光、光释光等主要考古测年方法对照，含测年范围、适用材料、原理与精度: Comparison of the main archaeological dating methods — carbon-14, thermoluminescence, optically stimulated luminescence — with ranges, applicable materials, principles and precision
map.判定遗址年代时，依据出土材料（木炭、骨骼、陶片、火山灰）选择合适的测年手段：有机: When dating a site, pick the method by the excavated material (charcoal, bone, pottery, volcanic ash): organic samples use carbon-14, fired clay and pottery use TL/OSL, and ancient volcanic rock uses potassium-argon.
map.校对付树轮年表（IntCal）将碳-14 年代（BP）换算为日历年代（cal B: IntCal calibration curves convert carbon-14 ages (BP) into calendar ages (cal BC/AD) with 1σ or 2σ confidence intervals.
map.对比多个测年结果时，用交叉定年互相校验——如 C14 与地层叠压关系冲突，需复检: When comparing several dating results, cross-check them with each other — e.g. if carbon-14 conflicts with stratigraphic superposition, recheck whether the sample was contaminated or the layer disturbed.
map.：测得样品剩余 14C 比例为现代值的 50%，按半衰期 5730 年：经过约: : a measured sample remaining 14C fraction of 50% of modern, with a half-life of 5730 years, means about 1 half-life ≈ 5730 years have passed, i.e. about 5730 BP; the IntCal curve then puts it at roughly 4550 BC (the calibrated range follows the latest curve).

map.碳-14 测年能测多老的样本？: How old a sample can carbon-14 dating measure?
map.碳-14 有效上限约 5 万年（约 8~9 个半衰期后信号接近本底）。更老的样品: The carbon-14 effective limit is about 50,000 years (after roughly 8~9 half-lives the signal approaches background). Older samples (e.g. Early Pleistocene, hominin fossils) need potassium-argon, argon-argon or uranium-series methods instead.
map.热释光和光释光有什么区别？: What is the difference between thermoluminescence and optically stimulated luminescence?
map.两者都测矿物（石英、长石）最后一次受热或见光后累计的辐射剂量。热释光（TL）常用: Both measure the accumulated radiation dose minerals (quartz, feldspar) received since their last heating or exposure to light. Thermoluminescence (TL) is used for fired clay and pottery sherds (reset by heat); optically stimulated luminescence (OSL) is used for sediments (reset by light), covering tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands of years and suiting the last exposure date of a stratum.
